entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the morning sun cast its golden..."
entries.dialogueText: As the morning sun cast its golden rays over the portrait-lined halls of the palace, I waited for Duke Reinhart to arrive.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The meeting, a follow-up on our rec..."
entries.dialogueText: The meeting, a follow-up on our recent Aureus gas field agreement, was crucial in solidifying our newfound cooperation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paced the grand reception hall, l..."
entries.dialogueText: I paced the grand reception hall, looking at its walls adorned with tapestries depicting the glorious history of Rizia, while Pabel was making sure everything was in order.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""What are you thinking? About that..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you thinking? About that map, I mean."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stopped in front of one massive t..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped in front of one massive tapestry map dated from the 7th century, which showed the Rezenid Empire at the height of its power.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The borders stretched far and wide,..."
entries.dialogueText: The borders stretched far and wide, including most of the current territories of current-day Morella, Derdia, Wehlen and the southern coasts of Lespia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was just thinking how much terri..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just thinking how much territory we've lost throughout the last centuries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing. I was just checking it ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. I was just checking it out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you think it's too aggressive?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think it's too aggressive? Having this in the reception hall?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I just really like history.""
entries.dialogueText: "I just really like history."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I thought as much.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought as much."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'm not so sure about that. Few th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not so sure about that. Few threads still link the ancient Rezenid Empire and modern-day Rizia."

entries.dialogueText: "I was wondering, {RiziaDLCText.PabelToPlayer}..."

entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""However...""
entries.dialogueText: "However..."

entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Don't you think that particular ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you think that particular map might be perceived a bit... negatively?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a very rare map depicting th..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a very rare map depicting the borders of the kingdom in the 18th century, showing Pales as part of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have a point, actually. Why di..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have a point, actually. Why did nobody notice this? Where the hell is Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. The Duke may take it..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. The Duke may take it the wrong way. Take it down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "That's absurd. It's just a map on a wall. The Duke wouldn't be offended by such a trivial thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even better. I want him to see tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even better. I want him to see that Pales was, and must be, Rizian territory."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He'll be welcoming our guest. Shou..."
entries.dialogueText: "He'll be welcoming our guest. Should I take it down?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Let it stay.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Let it stay."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take it down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Take it down."

entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel signaled to a pair of nearby..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel signaled to a pair of nearby servants. A few minutes later, they returned with a ladder and swiftly removed the map.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I suppose not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose not."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Oh. Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. Understood."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""See you soon.""
